description: Portfolio audit of one company's sites: scans every homepage (three indices + stop factors) and checks that the sites describe each product consistently (category, pricing, audience, claims, network), with verbatim quotes from both sides, deterministic checks (JSON-LD price / name mismatches, missing links between company and product) and a merged fix plan. Pass portfolio_id or a list of domains (each verified by you; admins: any). Starts a run when none is recent and returns the report summary when it is ready; call again with the same arguments to poll. Requires an account; each new homepage scan counts against your scan limit.

domains.description: Domains of one company (creates the portfolio if needed)

force_refresh.description: Start a new run even if a recent one exists

name.description: Portfolio name when created from domains

name: scan_portfolio
